## Description

What does this PR do? Why is it needed? Link related issues with `Fixes #<issue>` or `See also #<issue>`.

How have you tested this PR? Is there any missing testing?

Open as draft pull request if you're still working on it.

## Checklist

- [ ] Self-review completed (check "Files changed" tab in the GitHub PR)
- [ ] Docs updated for user-facing changes (`docs/source/`)
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` updated if this change invalidates a documented rule, command, or layout
